events.comment: The content (chapters, archangels, shadow-thoughts, gifts…) comes from assets/data/content.json, built by tools/build-content.mjs. The save lives in the browser storage and is merged over the defaults of the global variable Save.
The seven stand in an arc; the chosen one steps forward into the light.
A click on an archangel chooses him (the cursor is projected on the ground of the 3D layer).
Everything about the chosen archangel: name and meaning, the tradition that names him, his lore, his gift, his prayer, his trait, and how he is unlocked.
